item: Mold test kit (first item unpacked on arrival)
rationale: Crew 16 had a mold test, used it, and detected no harmful mold. The mission brief (not the crew) recommends running a mold test on Day 1 and making the mold test kit the first item unpacked on arrival. The crew's report notes mold was seen on entering and the test was run the following day.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV §4.6 Logistics and safety, lines 791-796, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; also §1.3 line 81 (mold test kits); crew account: SRC-flashline-crew-reports, FLASHLINE-16 DAILY REPORT 03-07-2024 (Mold Test item)
